headline:
Steady grower,
priced for fair value
chart_note: 52-week range: $173.33 - $281.07. Currently around $275, near the top of that range after steady mid-single-digit growth.
why_today: Down 1.2% today but still trading near its 52-week high ($281.07) - a defensive, dividend-paying blue chip with steady mid-single-digit growth.
pro_1: Trading near 52-week highs with steady growth - sales up 6.0% and EPS up 8.1% in 2025, guidance calls for a similar pace in 2026
pro_2: Beta of -0.53 makes this one of the more defensive large caps - historically moves somewhat independently of the broader market, plus a roughly 2% dividend
con_1: Average analyst price target is barely above the current price - limited near-term upside already priced in
con_2: PE of 18.3x isn't expensive for a blue chip, but growth here is single-digit, not the double-digit pace seen elsewhere in healthcare
